arguments.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: single transparent cartoon game sprite SMDATE1.BMP 013. Redraw image 1's exact pose, silhouette, visible fragments and motion in the polished cartoon style of images 2-4. Image 1 is the authoritative original pixel-art source, enlarged with nearest-neighbor; do not preserve its pixel stair steps or red-white dithering. Images 2 and 3 establish the same adult mermaid's yellow hair, cyan headband, warm peach skin, green swimsuit and green fish tail; image 4 establishes the forked fin design. They provide style and identity only, never substitute their poses.
Frame-specific subject: The adult mermaid inverted near the crest of a head-first dive, head and hands downward at lower right, yellow hair flowing along the right side above her head. Her long green fish tail arches across the top, forked fin at upper left, forming a broad inverted J shape. Both arms are bent at the elbows outward to the left and right, with hands close together below her head, forming a narrow diamond-shaped transparent opening between the arms. Preserve bent elbows; do not straighten the arms. Preserve original curve and empty center. White/cyan spray follows the left arc, small splash beneath. No human legs.
Style: clean smooth bold black cartoon outlines, saturated colors, restrained cel shading, readable anatomy and motion. White water foam with cyan outlines and a few cyan shadows matches the approved references. Preserve adult human upper-body proportions, anatomical hands when visible, and the original hidden or underwater regions. Do not add body parts that are absent from source.
Composition: one complete isolated sprite, source-relative silhouette and orientation preserved, centered with modest transparent margin; no other frame, montage, label, text or watermark. Actual transparent RGBA background, including empty gaps between splash strokes. No checkerboard baked in, no opaque background, no horizon or ocean scene.
